name: Arraiján

routes.outcome: Official municipal functions manual documents a Municipio de Arraiján cadastral/GIS unit responsible for maintaining municipal cadastral information, parcel cartography, digital cadastral mapping and GIS support. This establishes a local custodian and scope, not an open feature service.
Current official municipal portal identified; rendered content says the portal is temporarily in maintenance and technology update. No cadastral viewer or service endpoint was exposed.
Anonymous HTTPS GET succeeded, but only the maintenance page was available; no JavaScript/configuration for a parcel viewer was present.
Official open-data organization page identifies Municipio de Arraiján, but lists no public cadastral dataset or parcel service.
Municipal tax portal returned a login page. No login, credentials, taxpayer lookup, fiscal account query or unsafe field request was attempted.
Official ANATI service page describes cadastral control points and directs users to Cartography/Regional Administrations; it is a procedure, not an anonymous parcel geometry API.
Official ANATI plan-approval procedure confirms cadastral-plan workflows, but provides no public parcel feature response. No plan or parcel was requested.
Official MIVIOT Geoportal is publicly reachable and advertises planning/zoning layers, downloads and interoperable services; it is not evidenced as the Municipality of Arraiján cadastral source.

Anonymous ArcGIS organization search returned a Panama City land-use service and zoning items, but no Arraiján parcel FeatureServer. The land-use layer was not treated as cadastral and no geometry was retained.
Service metadata exposed one polygon layer named Uso de suelo Cd. de Panamá. It is a Panama City land-use layer, outside Arraiján and not a parcel registry; no query was made for unsafe fields.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Municipal portal currently exposes maintenance content; tax portal is login-gated. MIVIOT Geoportal and ArcGIS organization metadata were inspected as national/planning context.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: The official municipal manual refers generally to cadastral information and parcel cartography, but no parcel feature record or native key structure was obtained.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if exposed

qualification.reason: A local municipal cadastral/GIS custodian is evidenced, but no anonymous parcel layer, native identity, CRS or bounded parcel geometry response was obtained.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No exact-point parcel query succeeded; this is not evidence of citywide absence.
No parcel polygons are retained because no safe native-identity geometry response was obtained.
The Municipio de Arraiján is the local cadastral custodian; ANATI and MIVIOT are national agencies/general planning context, not substitutes for a local parcel layer.
The tax portal login wall was not bypassed and no credentials, CAPTCHA, private token or unsafe lookup was attempted.
The packet is complete as a research record, not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The municipality may hold cadastral geometry internally or behind its maintenance/login flows, but current public endpoint availability, native parcel identity, field schema, CRS, anonymous query behavior and citywide completeness remain unresolved.
